title: helper2
description: helper2.ai app: HTTP, federated search and sources, AI guide, Scout. Meters: docs/architecture.md#observability.

panels.title: Partial searches
panels.description: Share of searches over the last hour where at least one source failed or timed out.

panels.title: Guide budget left
panels.description: Model calls left today under the daily cap (ADR 0017).

panels.title: Stalest Scout source
panels.description: Age of the oldest last-success among Scout sources. Empty on staging (Scout off).

targets.expr: topk(8, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{application="helper2",environment="$environment",uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Search latency p50 / p95
panels.description: helper2.search.latency over all pods, from histogram buckets.

panels.title: Source latency p95
panels.description: helper2.source.latency per source over all pods, from histogram buckets.

panels.title: Outbound HTTP errors by host
panels.description: Source and collector calls; status CLIENT_ERROR / IO_ERROR included.

panels.title: Translation budget remaining
panels.description: Search query translations left under today's cap (helper2.search.daily-translations, UTC day). At 0 non-English queries run untranslated.

panels.title: Rate-limit decisions in memory (Redis down)
panels.description: helper2.rate-limit.fallback: per-client limits decided in one replica's memory because Redis was unavailable, so each replica allows the full limit. Should stay 0.

panels.title: Ask latency (mean)
panels.description: No buckets on helper2.guide.ask: mean = sum/count, plus Micrometer's rolling max.

panels.title: Model call p95 by step / model
Model calls by outcome
panels.description: A retry is a second sample. Outcomes: ok, rate_limited, unavailable, parse_error, error.

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: Only when the provider reports usage.

panels.title: Questions the model did not answer: shared, client quota, timeout
panels.description: shared: an identical question was already running and its answer was reused. client_quota: the asker's daily questions were used up, answered from search only (notice GUIDE_DAILY_QUOTA). timeout: the question passed helper2.guide.question-deadline and was cancelled (504).

panels.title: Time to first useful event by intent
panels.description: helper2.guide.first_useful: from the stream request to its first retrieved or clarify event (ADR 0026). Targets: p50 3 s, p95 8 s (alert Helper2GuideFirstUsefulSlow). Cached and shared answers are not timed.

panels.title: Time since last success
panels.description: Scout is off on staging (values-staging.yaml), so this row is empty there. Collector intervals differ (15 min to 5 days); compare with each source's interval.

panels.title: Runs by status
panels.description: Scout is off on staging (values-staging.yaml), so this row is empty there.

panels.title: Enrichment budget remaining
panels.description: Scout enrichment model calls left under today's cap (helper2.scout.daily-enrichment-calls, UTC day). At 0 resources wait in the backlog.

panels.title: Enrichments skipped as UNCHANGED
panels.description: Resources whose source text is the same as at their last successful enrichment: no model call. Compared with the enrichments that did call the model.

panels.title: UNCHANGED share of enrichments (1h)
panels.description: Share of enrichment attempts skipped because the source text did not change.

panels.title: Classifier budget remaining
panels.description: Awesome-list classifier model calls left under today's cap (helper2.scout.github-awesome.classifier-daily-calls, UTC day). At 0 the keyword rules classify.

panels.title: Embedding backlog
panels.description: Resources without a vector for the embedding model, read after each indexer batch. Empty without H2_NVIDIA_API_KEY (indexer off).

panels.title: Embedding failures by reason
panels.description: Failed indexer batches; the next batch retries the same resources.

panels.title: Time since last embedding batch
panels.description: Seconds since the indexer last stored a batch. It grows while the backlog is empty, which is fine; with a backlog it means the indexer is stuck.

panels.title: Scrape
panels.description: 1 = Alloy reaches the management port (8081). 0 or empty: pod down, or the NetworkPolicy blocks the observability namespace.

panels.title: Container memory vs limit
panels.description: The limit is 1Gi: the JVM heap plus metaspace, threads and buffers must fit, or the kernel OOM-kills the pod.

panels.title: Warnings and errors
panels.description: From the structured (logstash JSON) app log, shipped by the cluster Alloy.
